items.title: Editor M1: comment-preserving TOML writer and file store
items.description: First write the implementation plan for the whole visual editor from the agreed spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-visual-editor-design.md (no plan exists yet; docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-03-cross-repo-references.md is the pattern). Then build milestone 1, with no UI. (a) A file store interface: load a file with a token identifying its version, save only if the token still matches, and answer 'the version in the last commit'; nothing else in the editor touches the filesystem. (b) A span-level TOML writer built on internal/sheet/positions.go: each row, stage, interface field and top-level key is a span of lines; replace only changed spans, insert new ones, remove deleted ones. Changed spans are written in canonical form (key order and alignment of specs/order-checkout/sheet.toml, sub-tables indented two spaces). A comment block directly above a row moves and is deleted with it; section comments stay put; comments inside a changed span are kept where their key still exists. go-toml/v2 drops comments, so it cannot write. Done when every example sheet, flow and interface round-trips byte-for-byte when nothing changed, and edits change only the expected spans.

items.title: Editor M2: sheet editing (inputs, formulas, sends, rejects) and save
items.description: Milestone 2 of the visual editor (spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-visual-editor-design.md). `dsheets serve --edit`; serve stays read-only without the flag. Side panel on the sheet page: name, ID (locked after first save), description; rule kinds Input (source, type, usage, when, default), Formula (CEL, suggestions for rows and functions, `uses` filled from the formula, rows that would make a cycle not offered) and Text; sends including call sends (send.target); rejects; open questions; one-click 'add it as a request input' for names that are not rows yet. Unsaved-changes bar with Save and Discard; closing the tab with unsaved edits asks first. Save pipeline per the spec's 'Saving' section: conflict check through the store token; refuse only errors the edit introduces (compared by code, row and message); raise version by one at most once per commit; write; regenerate cases as `dsheets cases` does (cases.Preserve, the reference time already in cases.toml) and report the summary.

items.title: Editor M3: decision tables, lookups and live case preview
items.description: Milestone 3 of the visual editor. Decision-table grid: columns from rows you pick; cells take conditions such as `>= 2`, `-` or values; add, remove and reorder rules and condition columns; choose the hit policy; gaps and overlaps flagged while editing. Lookup form: `from` and `key`; inline `values` editable; values from a CSV values_file shown read-only with the file's path. Switching rule kind warns before discarding the old rule. Live preview: when typing pauses, run cases.Generate on the in-memory draft and show every case's result (or why there is none, such as 'rejected earlier') using the eval engine; the row's grid dots, rule and send column update before saving.

items.title: Editor M4: flow panel and interface re-import merges
items.description: Milestone 4 of the visual editor. Flow page with review marks always on. Panel for a value row: 'compute here' on every possible step pins it (writes computes or callee_computes); unpinning returns it to automatic placement. For each mark on an interface file in this repository: add field (name, type, required) or map to an existing field (writes carries). Interfaces reached through an alias: source are read-only. Adding a field to an imported interface warns and writes `local = true`. '+ stage' between columns and stage editing (kind, interfaces, producer, caller, callee). Serving a flow with --edit also makes its end-to-end sheet editable when that sheet is in this repository. Change `dsheets interface import` to merge when the file exists: keep `local = true` fields absent from the schema, drop the mark once the schema has the field, print the fields kept; add `local` to schema/interface.schema.json and docs/flows.md.

items.title: Row-level diffs for pull requests
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 8. Show changes as row-level sheet differences rather than text diffs; for flows, as boundary and interface differences (fields added or dropped, who computes what). Starts from the same committed-versus-edited comparison as T-6, so design the two together.

items.title: Turn a sheet change into implementation work per team
items.description: From 'Related work' in the visual-editor spec. Turn the difference between the committed files and the edited ones (sheets, flows, interfaces) into requirements for whoever implements them: per team, what to compute, send, carry or add to a schema. Works whether the change came from the editor, an LLM or a hand edit, which is why it is not part of the editor. To be brainstormed after the editor; shares its comparison with T-5.

items.title: Formatter and pre-commit hook
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 7. Canonical formatting (`dsheets fmt` or a taplo fmt configuration) and a pre-commit hook. Should be cheap once T-1's canonical span writer exists: reuse its canonical layout so the editor and the formatter never disagree.

items.title: Lists: derive or send one value per item
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 3; an open question from the original handoff. Arrays import as a single `array` field, and there is no way to derive or send one value per item. Likely shape: a group of rows with a shared 'for each' label, as tax forms handle repeated dependents. Needs a design conversation. It changes sheet.toml, so the editor's forms (T-2 to T-4) would have to cover it; T-1 works on line spans and does not depend on it.

items.title: Evidence per piece and per team in flows
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 2. Evidence is recorded per sheet. There is no view of evidence per piece or per team inside a flow, or in the combined grid.

items.title: Draft rows from natural language with an LLM
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 9 (Phase 2 of the original handoff). Ambiguities must become open_questions, never guesses.

items.title: DMN XML export
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 10 (Phase 2). Export only, never execution, for viewing in existing DMN tools. Only matters if FEEL or DMN tooling becomes important; CEL stays the expression language until then.

items.title: Draft sheets from existing code
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 11 (Phase 3: documenting existing code without changing it). An LLM proposes sheets from existing code, including SQL strings and config keys.

items.title: Production evidence from OpenTelemetry traces
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 12 (Phase 3). Configured at the process level, with payloads redacted before storage. The evidence model already has a `trace` run kind and internal/evidence.Store is an interface; nothing ingests traces yet.

items.title: Scheduled database and config snapshots with diffs
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 13 (Phase 3). Snapshots on a schedule, with a diff view between snapshots.

items.title: Replay captured requests through the evaluator
items.description: BACKLOG.md item 14 (Phase 3). Replay captured requests through the evaluator and compare with the payloads actually sent, to verify inferred rows.
